name: Agora Dollar
notes: Research candidate for a current USD stablecoin. Verify issuer structure, reserve composition, redemption access, deployments, and relationship to other AUSD symbols before promotion.

name: World Liberty Financial USD
notes: Research candidate for a fiat-backed USD stablecoin. Verify legal issuer, reserves, redemption terms, launch chronology, and supported chains.

name: Ethena USDtb
notes: Research candidate for Ethena's treasury-backed stable asset. Keep separate from USDe and verify reserve vehicles, redemption access, issuer relationships, and deployments.

name: Mountain Protocol USD
notes: Research candidate for a yield-bearing fiat/RWA-backed USD token. Use a disambiguated ID and slug because SOG already uses USDm for Mento Dollar.

name: Quantoz USDQ
notes: Research candidate for a regulated USD electronic-money token. Verify issuer authorization, safeguarding, redemption scope, deployments, and launch history.

name: DOLA
notes: Protocol-stablecoin candidate. Verify issuance modules, collateral, governance, bad-debt or incident history, redemption mechanics, and canonical deployments.

name: Djed
notes: Protocol-stablecoin candidate. Verify reserve-coin mechanics, overcollateralization, issuer/operator roles, launch chronology, and Cardano deployment evidence.

name: Vai
notes: Protocol-stablecoin candidate. Verify minting, collateral and governance, peg incidents, debt settlement, and current issuance/redemption status.

name: Lista USD
notes: Resolve the HAY to lisUSD identity, rebrand chronology, contract continuity, collateral model, and whether historical HAY events belong to one continuous record.

name: Kujira USK
notes: Historical/current-status review candidate. Verify mint shutdown or wind-down stages, remaining liabilities, liquidity, redemption paths, and successor-network relationships.

name: Staked USDe
notes: Boundary candidate for a reward-accruing receipt over USDe. Determine whether it merits a first-class asset record or only a yield-wrapper relationship to USDe.

name: Savings DAI
notes: Boundary candidate for the DAI Savings Rate wrapper. Verify contract history, convertibility, lifecycle after the Sky transition, and relationship to DAI and sUSDS.

name: Savings USDS
notes: Boundary candidate for the Sky Savings Rate wrapper. Verify issuance, transferability, yield source, and relationship to USDS and legacy sDAI.

name: Ondo US Dollar Yield
notes: Boundary candidate for a tokenized yield-bearing dollar instrument. Verify legal classification, transfer restrictions, redemption, reserve assets, and whether it belongs in SOG's stable-value scope.

name: Hashnote US Yield Coin
notes: Boundary candidate representing an onchain fund interest. Verify fund-share legal structure, transfer restrictions, redemption, reserve portfolio, and SOG inclusion policy.

name: StraitsX Singapore Dollar
notes: Regional-fiat candidate. Verify issuer history, reserve and safeguarding structure, redemption eligibility, supported networks, and regulatory status.

name: JPYC
notes: Regional-fiat candidate. Separate legacy prepaid-payment versions from any regulated stablecoin launch and verify contract continuity, redemption, reserves, and issuer licensing.

name: GYEN
notes: Regional-fiat candidate. Verify legal issuer, reserve attestations, redemption access, chain deployments, and historical market incidents.

name: Brazilian Digital Token
notes: Regional-fiat candidate. Verify issuer entities, reserve disclosures, redemption terms, supported chains, and launch chronology.

name: BiLira
notes: Regional-fiat candidate. Verify issuer structure, reserve and redemption arrangements, current issuance, deployments, and jurisdictional constraints.

name: Angle Euro
notes: Euro candidate. Resolve agEUR to EURA rebrand or migration, contract continuity, reserve model changes, redemption access, and current issuer/operator structure.

name: EUR CoinVertible
notes: Regulated-euro candidate. Verify legal classification, permitted holders, collateral segregation, redemption, launch chronology, and deployments.

name: Eurite
notes: Regulated-euro candidate. Verify issuing bank entity, safeguarding, subscription and redemption access, networks, and MiCA chronology.

name: Quantoz EURQ
notes: Regulated-euro candidate. Verify issuer authorization, safeguarding, redemption scope, launch chronology, and deployments.

name: VNX Swiss Franc
notes: Swiss-franc candidate. Verify issuer entity, reserve backing, redemption access, regulatory treatment, and supported networks.

name: Empty Set Dollar
notes: Historical algorithmic-stablecoin candidate. Record elastic-supply design, peg failure, governance, contract history, and terminal lifecycle evidence.

name: Basis Cash
notes: Historical seigniorage-style stablecoin candidate. Record cash, bond, and share mechanics, peg collapse, contracts, and final lifecycle state.

name: Dynamic Set Dollar
notes: Historical elastic-supply stablecoin candidate. Record protocol mechanics, peg deterioration, migration or successor claims, contracts, and terminal status.

name: Cashio Dollar
notes: Historical failure candidate. Record Solana identity, collateral design, March 2022 infinite-mint exploit, loss of peg, remediation, and terminal state.

name: Acala Dollar
notes: Historical incident and lifecycle candidate. Verify the 2022 erroneous-mint exploit, recovery and governance actions, later aSEED transition, remaining liabilities, and final aUSD status.
